description: Allows acquiring of vanilla/mod assets at runtime instead of including them in builds potentially violating licenses.

releases.notes:
## Bug Fix

- Null minecraft home for server side *[commit by @Rongmario in 4dd0cae]*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/AssetMover/compare/3.0.0...3.0.1

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is a new major version (2.x → 3.x).

## Feature

- Fire MoveAssetEvent.Server during pre-initialization on the dedicated server *[commit by @Rongmario in e79c59f]*
- **api**: Split MoveAssetEvent into client and server events *[commit by @Rongmario in 9e51720]*
- Report move progress and size the pool from available cores *[commit by @Rongmario in e491642]*
- Per-source download timeouts and versioned user agent *[commit by @Rongmario in 0c42724]*
- **api**: Generalise GitHub sources into GitHost *[commit by @Rongmario in dd24ed0]*
- **api**: Event-based 3.0 API with parallel downloads *[commit by @Rongmario in 77b229a]*

## Bug Fix

- Pop the progress bar when moving is interrupted *[commit by @Rongmario in 51a8aa5]*
- Name sources readably in progress and logs *[commit by @Rongmario in 19af04e]*
- Register the 2.x listener during construction and point the icon at its moved path *[commit by @Rongmario in 40ee1aa]*
- **build**: Limit token replacement to the main source set *[commit by @Rongmario in 9287e1b]*
- **api**: Resolve CurseForge files through curse.cleanroommc.com *[commit by @Rongmario in a3f81b5]*

## Documentation

- Document every API parameter *[commit by @Rongmario in 60ee021]*

## Testing

- Cover archive extraction, sharing, skipping, checksums and timeouts *[commit by @Rongmario in 2cf5e40]*

## Build and Dependencies

- **deps**: Update conventions to 1.4.4 *[commit by @Rongmario in d3b475b]*
- Migrate to Cleanroom's Conventions 1.4.2 *[commit by @Rongmario in 72bcf50]*
- **deps**: Update gradle wrapper to 9.8.1 *[commit by @Rongmario in 4801fe8]*

## Other

- Finalized v3 API! *[commit by @Rongmario in 0c412f9]*
- Update buildscript *[commit by @Rongmario in f8e7090]*
- Fix version json file path *[commit by @jbredwards in af7fc8b]*
- Fixes #14 *[commit by @jbredwards in ba2373d, issue by @juraj-hrivnak]*
- Update README code block to show v2.5 *[commit by @Rongmario in 1dad932]*

## First-time Contributors

- **@jbredwards made their first contribution!**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/AssetMover/compare/2.5...3.0.0
